text: **One backend seam, two backends.** Rust owns a `WalletBackend` trait. NWC (NIP-47) is the Lightning/BOLT-11 backend; Cashu (NIP-60) is the ecash backend. A composition layer picks which backend handles a given action. Zaps (NIP-57) don't know or care which — they just emit a "pay this" intent through a `PaymentPort` and the selected backend fulfills it.
